summary.lv: ZABBIX SIA meklē Technical Marketing Engineer (Product Ambassador), kurš/-a būs Zabbix produkta tehniski kompetentais pārstāvis, veidos demonstrācijas, bloga rakstus un webinār saturu.
summary.en: Zabbix is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer (Product Ambassador) to serve as the technical face of the product, creating hands-on demos, blogs, labs, and webinars while bridging engineering and marketing teams.
